operating_income.source: Adobe Q4 earnings press releases (8-K ex99.1) for FY23/FY24/FY25: GAAP operating income quoted as $6.65B, $6.74B, $8.71B; rounded to $10M, check against 10-K

d_and_a.source: Sum of four quarterly 'Depreciation, amortization and accretion' lines in Adobe 8-Ks FY25 (217+209+208+184) and FY24 (212+214+213+218); FY2023 not found

capex.source: Sum of quarterly 'Purchases of property and equipment' in Adobe 8-Ks FY25 (26+47+72+34) and FY24 (37+41+57+48); FY2023 not found

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 11% (10-K: 23,769 vs 21,505); fade ~50bp per year as the base grows and AI competition matures

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: held near FY2025 GAAP margin of 36.6% (8,710/23,769)

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approximates Adobe's recent effective rate of about 18-19%; not verified against the 10-K tax note

wacc.source: Assumption: Rf ~4.3%, beta ~1.1, ERP ~5% gives cost of equity ~9.8%; little debt, so WACC ~9.5%. Not data-sourced.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal GDP-like growth, below WACC

net_debt.source: Adobe FY2025 10-K at Nov 28 2025: senior notes carrying value ~$6.21B (par $6.15B) minus cash 5,431 minus short-term investments 1,164 = 6,210-6,595 = -385

diluted_shares.source: Adobe FY2025 10-K EPS note: weighted average diluted shares ~427 million. Check the decimal against the filing.
